commitment_rule: A separate PREQUERY_EXECUTION.json may claim commitment only after exact plan and code bytes are verified against an existing Git commit before any target query.

exposure_boundary.projection: Original gh api --jq allowed fields only; never contents/blob/raw endpoints, PR bodies, patches, CI or commit messages.

metadata_predicates.file_metadata_pagination: Original v2 scan: per_page=100 until fewer than 100; refusal if 3000-file API ceiling is not closed.
metadata_predicates.production_changed_status: Every production .py file is modified, hence preexisting.
metadata_predicates.tests_classifier: Original v2 is_test: .py plus test/tests/testing component, test_ basename, _test.py suffix, or conftest.py.
metadata_predicates.title_or_label: Case-insensitive title starts fix OR a label contains bug.

selection_algorithm: Inspect the latest at most 100 closed PRs per nonexcluded repository, page=1, per_page=100, sort=updated, direction=desc. Retain every PR and fixed-predicate reason. Take the first qualifying PR per repository in returned order. Bind every chosen base/head commit and changed blob using Git metadata only, retaining any binding failure without retargeting. The complete resulting pool, in fixed repository order, is committed before independent admission screening. Screen every pool member; choose the first two source-distinct admitted members. Native PASS and FAIL are identical for eligibility and remain sealed from the learner. If the selected training case has no failing native residual, stop G2 UNKNOWN; do not replace it.
universe_order: Ascending lexicographic full name; no expansion on shortfall.

untouched_assessment.basis: Exact frozen historical metadata, both prior frontier universes and selected tasks, and original known native-domain identifier.
untouched_assessment.boundary: Bounded accessible-record unfamiliarity only; no claim about all prior human/model knowledge or all inaccessible research.
